Description: Private SonarQube Community Build lab: no inbound ports; GitHub main OIDC limited to a fixed-port SSM document. Single host, not HA.

SubnetId.Description: Private EKS subnet with working NAT/HTTPS egress

Properties.GroupDescription: Sonar host: outbound HTTPS only; no inbound ports

Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
# Do not enable shell tracing: database credentials never belong in cloud-init logs.
dnf install -y docker python3
systemctl enable --now docker amazon-ssm-agent
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/99-sonarqube.conf <<'SYSCTL'
vm.max_map_count=524288
fs.file-max=131072
SYSCTL
sysctl --system >/dev/null
mkdir -p /opt/market-intel-sonar /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
cd /opt/market-intel-sonar
# Pin Compose and verify against the vendor's versioned release checksum.
curl --fail --silent --show-error --location https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/v2.40.1/docker-compose-linux-x86_64 -o /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
expected='5bc26235e4de0be2aa350c13c33bd226d760d3b44cbd29820708788e02a2b6f2'
actual=hashlib.sha256(Path('/usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if expected != actual: raise SystemExit('Compose checksum mismatch')
PY
chmod 755 /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
if [ ! -f .env ]; then
  python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import secrets
Path('.env').write_text('DB_PASSWORD=' + secrets.token_urlsafe(48) + '\n')
PY
fi
chmod 600 .env
cat > compose.yaml <<'COMPOSE'
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:17.11-alpine3.23@sha256:bc2701f9a79f9248bcb18743bc9b2c732d9a1d16737ca44a8f577752fc43b61f
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: sonar
      POSTGRES_DB: sonar
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: $DB_PASSWORD
    volumes:
      - postgresql:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: [CMD-SHELL, 'pg_isready -U sonar -d sonar']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 15
    mem_limit: 1g
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: {max-size: 10m, max-file: '3'}
  sonarqube:
    image: ${SonarImage}
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      db: {condition: service_healthy}
    ports:
      - '127.0.0.1:9000:9000'
    environment:
      SONAR_JDBC_URL: jdbc:postgresql://db:5432/sonar
      SONAR_JDBC_USERNAME: sonar
      SONAR_JDBC_PASSWORD: $DB_PASSWORD
      SONAR_FORCEAUTHENTICATION: 'true'
    volumes:
      - sonarqube_data:/opt/sonarqube/data
      - sonarqube_extensions:/opt/sonarqube/extensions
      - sonarqube_logs:/opt/sonarqube/logs
    ulimits:
      nofile: {soft: 131072, hard: 131072}
      nproc: {soft: 8192, hard: 8192}
    mem_limit: 5g
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options: {max-size: 10m, max-file: '3'}
volumes:
  postgresql:
  sonarqube_data:
  sonarqube_extensions:
  sonarqube_logs:
COMPOSE
chmod 600 compose.yaml
cat > /etc/systemd/system/market-intel-sonar.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Private Market Intel SonarQube and PostgreSQL
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
WorkingDirectory=/opt/market-intel-sonar
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker compose up -d --wait --wait-timeout 900
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker compose stop
TimeoutStartSec=1200
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now market-intel-sonar
